title: Commercial Drones Now Outnumber Hobby Drones By 82,301
hook: The drone boom became a business before hobbyists noticed.
closing: More commercial drones mean the shared sky is becoming infrastructure, not just recreation.
question: Have you flown a drone?

segments.say: Commercial drones reached 453,635, overtaking recreational registrations. The toy craze became an industry.
Registered drones climbed to 837,513, putting more aircraft than ever into the shared sky.
New drone registrations slowed to 10,500 monthly. The market is still growing, but the boom is cooling.
